text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Storytelling with Data Site

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        npm install -g cdl-slides

    - name: Extract images
      run: scripts/extract-images.py

    - name: Build slides
      run: scripts/build-slides.sh

    - name: Build pages
      run: scripts/build-pages.py

    - name: Build gallery
      run: scripts/build-gallery.py

    - name: Build PDFs
      run: scripts/build-pdfs.py

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: _site
```
